content.short: ChangeHero is an instant non-custodial exchange service supporting 300+ digital assets.
content.description: ChangeHero is an instant swap service that exchanges between hundreds of cryptocurrencies without an account. A user sends the asset they hold and receives the requested one at a rate quoted up front, in either a fixed or floating form. The service is non-custodial in the sense that it holds funds only for the duration of the swap.
content.meta: ChangeHero is an instant non-custodial exchange supporting swaps across 300+ digital assets.
